sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, card C13487-K1 was used for an unauthorized online transaction of $74.96. The transaction was flagged due to the use of a device profile that has been identified as 'New' to the account and routed through an anonymous proxy. A device-ring probe revealed that this specific device profile has been utilized across 43 different cards to conduct 79 transactions within the last 120 days. This activity is consistent with the 'card_not_present_new_device' fraud typology, where stolen card information is used online from unrecognized devices. Similar patterns were previously identified and confirmed as fraud in cases CC-4241, CC-3954, and CC-2675. The consistent use of anonymous proxies and the high volume of cards associated with this single device profile indicate a coordinated effort to commit financial fraud. In accordance with policy R6, the institution has blocked the affected card and initiated monitoring of all other cards associated with this device profile. The cardholder has been notified, and the transaction has been marked for reversal to mitigate further financial exposure.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded after confirming the fraudulent nature of the transaction and identifying the device as part of a widespread, multi-card fraud ring, necessitating immediate card blocking and monitoring.
